payload.name: Scarcity-induced impulse buying
payload.fact: Scarcity cues, including limited-time and limited-quantity promotions, are positively associated with increased consumer impulse buying behavior.
payload.boundary: Context of e-commerce, live streaming, and quick commerce platforms.
